mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the moon was most worthwhile: the grazing impact and subsequent gathering explained why some debris remained in orbit while other fragments fell back or escaped.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to combine the molten world with orbiting rubble was least worthwhile; the feedback showed that another step was needed but did not explain why the rubble could not yet gather.

surprise.text: The initial unsuccessful pairing automatically combined the pebbles with shattered grains instead, revealing a gravitational-collapse route to rocky bodies.

arbitrary.text: The need for a second large impact before using the existing orbiting rubble was not clear beforehand, although the result explained how the grazing collision supplied debris.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the contrasting outcomes of impacts and the reassembly of fragments made the physical story engaging.
